The pirates of {wiki:Nargor} started mining crystals in a cursed cave, the {wiki:Crystal Gardens}, and strange things began to happen. The pirate {npc:One-Eyed Joe} asks you to destroy the evil crystal deep inside, using a banshee's petrified wail. You can repeat this task every day and you get a {item:Crystal Shard}, a random pirate accessory and the achievement Wail of the Banshee.
Strange things started to happen after the Nargor pirates began mining crystals in a cursed cave...
Access to Nargor: {wiki:Eleonore Quest} completed and {wiki:Meriana Quest} done up to *Ray's Mission 1*.
to make the {item:Molten Wax} (or already have a Molten Wax)
One of these, at random: {item:Eye Patch}, {item:Peg Leg}, {item:Hook} or {item:Pirate Backpack}
This task can be repeated **daily**: the cursed crystal regenerates over time.
You only need **one** {item:Molten Wax}: you do not lose it when you use it.

If you only want the {item:Flask of Medusa's Ointment} for the Dream Courts Quest, you can stop after creating it (section 4). If you finish the mission, the flask is used up and you have to wait 24 hours to create another.

Use a {item:Honeycomb} on an {item:Oven|oven} to get the {item:Molten Wax}. There is an oven in {npc:Eclesius}'s house and another in Nargor, on the same floor as {npc:One-Eyed Joe} but far to the **west**, on the other side of the shipyard.
You get the other items ({item:Green Crystal Splinter}, {item:Flask of Embalming Fluid} and {item:Petrified Scream}) as creature loot.

{wiki:Nargor} is an island **west** of Liberty Bay. In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} at the dock and say {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes} to go to **Meriana** (50 gp; you need the *Access to Meriana* mission of the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}). In Meriana, **south** of Sabrehaven, talk to {npc:Sebastian} and ask for passage to Nargor: {key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes} (50 gp). One-Eyed Joe is **south** of where Sebastian drops you, east of the two ships.
Travel to **Nargor** and go to {npc:One-Eyed Joe}.
On the way you meet 2 {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, 6 {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders} and one {creature:Pirate Cutthroat}.
Grind the crystal in the Wooden Grinder

Go down the ladder next to One-Eyed Joe and go **west**, turning **south** where the cave splits. At the end of the path you find a {item:Wooden Grinder}. Use the {item:Green Crystal Splinter} on the Wooden Grinder to get a {item:Pinch of Crystal Dust}.
Here there are {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders}, {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Pirate Cutthroats} and {creature:Pirate Buccaneer|Pirate Buccaneers}.
Going down to the next floor
Go back, but instead of going up the ladder, go down to the next floor.
Way down to the next floor

On this floor there are {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Pirate Cutthroats}, {creature:Pirate Skeleton|Pirate Skeletons}, {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders} and {creature:Pirate Ghost|Pirate Ghosts}.

Go **west**, turn **north** at the crossing and then **west** again. Follow the cave **south** until you find a {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)} on the left side. Search it to find a paper ({item:Crystal Gardens (Book)}). Then go back to the ladder.
Pile of Bones with the paper (optional)
From the ladder go **south** and follow the cave to a large room. On the **west** side of that room there is a {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)}: search it to get a {item:Small Crystal Bell}.
Pile of Bones with the Small Crystal Bell

Go down the ramp in the same room. Go **southwest** from the ramp until you find a {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)} with a {item:Pirate Flag (Banner)|pirate flag} next to it saying *"Beware! Dangerous monsters down here!"*.
You find about 3 {creature:Pirate Skeleton|Pirate Skeletons}, 2 {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}, 1 {creature:Wyvern} and 2 {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}.
Enter the teleport: you appear one floor down.
Here there are 2 {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers} and possibly {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} and a {creature:Drillworm}.
Go **northeast** to a {item:Bloodstained Crystal}. As you approach you get a message about an ancient inscription. Use the Bloodstained Crystal to get a {item:Vial of Medusa Blood}.
Take the Vial of Medusa Blood

Use the {item:Flask of Embalming Fluid} on the {item:Vial of Medusa Blood} to create a {item:Flask with Oil and Blood}. Message: *"You mixed the first ingredients to create a special ointment. But it isn't complete yet."*

Use the {item:Flask with Oil and Blood} on the {item:Pinch of Crystal Dust} to create the {item:Flask of Medusa's Ointment}. Message: *"You mixed the proper ingredients to create a special ointment. With this salve you may unpetrify a petrified object."*
If you are creating the Flask of Medusa's Ointment for the Dream Courts Quest, you can stop here. Finishing the mission uses up the flask and you would have to wait 24 hours to create another.
Go back through the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)} and go **west**. Follow the cave **northwest** until it turns **southwest**. Keep going southwest until you reach a room with a lake.
{creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}, {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}, {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} and {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} along the way.

Use the {item:Small Crystal Bell} to make a {item:Water Vortex} appear in the centre of the lake. Message: *"As you use the small bell an unearthly sound rings out sweetly. At the same moment, the lake's waters begin to whirl."*
Lake where the Water Vortex appears
Enter the {item:Water Vortex}: you appear one floor below, in a room with many {item:Black Crystal|Black Crystals}. In the middle of the big crystal formation is the {item:Large Black Crystal}.
Here there is 1 {creature:Crystalcrusher}, about 5 {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders} and 1 {creature:Frost Dragon}.
Use the {item:Molten Wax} on yourself to protect your ears.
Do this before you release the scream.

Use the {item:Flask of Medusa's Ointment} on the {item:Petrified Scream}, next to the Large Black Crystal. The unpetrified scream destroys the crystal. Message: *"You unpetrify a banshee's scream near the evil crystal, your ears protected by wax. Thus the baleful artefact is destroyed."*
Use the Molten Wax on yourself and the Flask of Medusa's Ointment on the Petrified Scream
Go down the hole to the **left** of the crystal and head **northeast**.
Hole to the left of the crystal
Step into the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)} to appear in a small empty room.
Step into another {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)} to appear **northeast** of the lake where you dived.
Follow the cave **southeast**, continuing **northeast** when it bends. Go up the ramp.
You meet the same creatures as on the way to the lake.
Go **west** and follow the cave to the {item:Ladder|ladder}. Climb it and climb another ladder to {npc:One-Eyed Joe}.
Just say {key:hi} to {npc:One-Eyed Joe} and the mission is complete.
Crystal Shard + Eye Patch, Peg Leg, Hook or Pirate Backpack (random) and the Wail of the Banshee achievement
Go back **north** to {npc:Sebastian} and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (100 gp) to return directly to Liberty Bay (or {key:meriana} for 50 gp).
